[[Grenz Frontier (Kurzick)|Grenz Frontier]] is one of five outposts used for entering [[Alliance battle]]s from the [[Kurzick]] side.

==Getting there==
Speak to a [[Kurzick Kommandant]] at a Kurzick [[guild hall]] or a [[Shady Luxon]] inside [[Grenz Frontier (Luxon)]], when the [[Kurzick-Luxon border]] is in Kurzick territory.
